entries.name: Chris Redfield
entries.referenceUse: Old mapping inspected; generation references the accepted new native32 appearance
entries.sourceReference: Resident Evil 5 : Chris commence avec un M92F et sa riposte de corps-à-corps comprend Straight. Le couvert réduit les dégâts sans résistance surnaturelle.
entries.characterVersion: Chris Redfield, default BSAA field outfit in Resident Evil5(2009): muscular adult man, short brown hair, light stubble, olive tactical vest/webbing over a LIGHT TAN short-sleeved collared shirt, small BSAA shoulder patch, exposed muscular forearms, dark charcoal cargo trousers, brown-black tactical boots, black fingerless gloves, utility belt and visible M92F thigh holster. No later black turtleneck, winter coat, bionic armor or transformed form.

entries.sourceReference: Resident Evil 2 (2019) : Claire utilise SLS 60 et GM 79 à grenades incendiaires. Le repli est une adaptation physique et non une esquive spéciale absente de ce jeu.
entries.characterVersion: Claire Redfield, default Resident Evil2 remake2019: adult woman with auburn hair in a high practical ponytail, red leather motorcycle jacket with sleeves pushed up, dark charcoal scoop-neck top, fitted dark blue denim jeans, brown leather belt/hip holster and brown lace boots, dark fingerless gloves. No1998 biker shorts, no Revelations outfit, no superhuman armor.

entries.sourceReference: Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways (2005) : Ada utilise le Blacktail et l’arbalète à carreaux explosifs. Le repli ne lui attribue pas le combat au grappin du remake de 2023.
entries.characterVersion: Ada Wong, an ADULT woman in Resident Evil4 Separate Ways ORIGINAL2005: short sleek black bob, elegant red HALTER-NECK full-length Chinese-style dress with bare shoulders and BARE ARMS, subtle gold butterfly embroidery, high side slit with a practical black thigh holster/strap, black high-heeled shoes and black choker. Fully clothed, neutral tactical presentation, no sexualized camera. No long sleeves, red sweater, black tights, boots,2023 grapple equipment or costume mixing.
